name: Image Toolbox
insteadOf: Batch image processing / offline image tools
hook: Powerful offline image toolbox for batch resizing, conversion, compression, and image operations.
bullets: Batch resize, crop, rotate, and convert images
Compress, optimize, and adjust image quality
Background removal, EXIF editing, and drawing tools
benefits: Process multiple images in one go without uploading
Fine-grained control over size, format, and compression
Privacy-first: all work happens on your device
setupSteps: Select images for batch or single operation
details: Image Toolbox (by T8RIN) is an offline-first Android app for batch image processing. Resize, crop, rotate, convert between formats, compress, remove backgrounds, edit EXIF, apply filters, and chain operations — all without sending images to the cloud.
